batting.name: HH Gibbs
batting.dismissal: c SR Tendulkar b DS Kulkarni

batting.name: TL Suman
batting.dismissal: c PR Shah b DJ Bravo

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c DJ Bravo b SL Malinga

batting.name: ST Jayasuriya
batting.dismissal: c RJ Harris b RP Singh

batting.name: PR Shah
batting.dismissal: c DR Smith b TL Suman

batting.name: JP Duminy
batting.dismissal: c AC Gilchrist b RG Sharma

batting.name: DJ Bravo
batting.dismissal: c RJ Harris b TL Suman

batting.name: SS Tiwary
batting.dismissal: st AC Gilchrist b RG Sharma

balls.text: good shot, uses his feet to meet the ball on the full, Harris bunts it down to long-on and with Teja sprints hard to get Deccan through to 145
shuffles across his stumps and clips the ball from off stump, uppishly wide of midwicket, Bravo again comes in the picture but returns a wild throw that gives away more
another good yorker on off stump, Harris makes room and just gets a bit of bat on ball, swinging it wide of midwicket, Tendulkar does the fielding
just a bit astray on the yorker and Harris drives past mid-on for two
another full one in the blockhole, Harris makes sure to get his toes out of the way as he clips the ball back down the track and Malinga stick out a hand to field

put that down to smart work from the wicketkeeper! Its another gem of a yorker on the stumps, swung away with an inside edge past midwicket, Rao runs the first hard and then dives as he comes back on the second, Shah has to extend the hand to his right after he collects and knocks the stumps over and after a couple replays its ruled that Rao is out because his bat was in the air even though it was over the line ... really well collected by Shah, it wasn't an accurate throw back from Bravo in the deep
again he makes room and hits this one over covers, another loose shot and should have been taken but Tendulkar ran a bit ahead of himself and didn't take it
slower ball outside off, short of a length, Rao makes room and looks to hit it over point but gets a thick outside edge well wide of the wicketkeeper so thats four more
short just outside off, he swings it through midwicket for an easy two
slides down the pads, Teja is late on the flick but gets a leg bye
slower ball, short of a length, Rao makes room and mistimes the pull
oh Rao! Bravo serves it up just outside the blockhole and Rao makes room, taking it off the toe end of the bat and picking out the gap behind point for four
change of pace, still full and straight, Rao clips it off the toes for one
attempted yorker outside off, Teja inside-edges wide of midwicket
dug in this time, he hops up and drops it down past backward point
ah, lovely ball but no reaction from umpire Benson! Full, straight, curling back in and that would just have missed leg stump .. but what bowling at the death
fired in wide of off stump and thats jammed into the covers

now there's a theatrical catch from Bravo in the deep! Malinga pitches on a length, Rohit clears the front leg and swings it away, its another mishit over midwicket and Bravo runs in from long-on and dives forward to take the catch ... now he didn't need to dive but the showman that Bravo is, he flung himself up at the last second to get the crowd cheering
again he makes room, Jayasuriya is alert and fires it in, Rao slashes with an inside edge to short third man and wants one but Rohit says thats enough now
fired in outside leg and he paddles it away for a couple
dances out, making room, and clears mid-off with a miscue, good stuff
well bowled, sees Rohit shuffling and absolutely fires it into the blockhole and he just manages to get a touch on it for a single toward midwicket
shuffles out and clips the ball on the full for two out to deep midwicket
backs away to outside leg stump and plays a very delicate shot, back-cutting excellently and picking the gap at backward point for a much needed boundary
gets right across the stumps and paddles a low full toss from well outside off stump, for all his cheeky efforts he only gets a single down to deep square leg
dances out and collects it off the toe end, straight to extra cover
again Rao chases the ball, rolling the wrists, and chops to gully
pitched up wide of off stump, Rao chases and cannot connect
kneels down and swings across the line, not timed well but he gets a single out to the deep midwicket sweeper to raise the 100 for Deccan
wide ball but he steps across and reaches out again, chopping to gully
comes out, makes room, reaches out to drive but picks out Harbhajan in the covers, who reacts well and saves a couple
comes out and drives the ball down to long-on
makes room and pushes to wide of extra cover for one

uses his feet to make room, Jayasuriya sees him and fires it wide, Rohit clips on the full past midwicket and gets one, theres a call for the second but he's stuck and Rao says come one, I'll take one for the team but the bowler doesn't collect the throw from Bravo too well and then returns a worse throw to Shah at the other end so in all is well for Deccan
full and flat on off, Rao makes room and punches past cover
bowling! Pitches on leg and rips across Rao, with some good bounce, beats the bat and well taken by Shah behind the stumps
again early onto the front foot and driving, but with too much bottom hand this time and Kulkarni fields the ball in his follow through
reaches out to drive a fuller ball but is very lucky to get a thick inside back past the stumps, with fine leg up Rohit gets his first four of whats been an iffy innings so far
pitched up and there's a nice push back past bowler and mid-off
a bit of width and he's off the mark with a steer past backward point
gets a bit of room and drives the ball into the gap at cover for one
down leg and he plays a big pull but there's no bat on ball and it hits the pads and drops near Rohit's feet
timber! Smith just sees the shorter length and backs away to pull it over midwicket but he does not connect at all and the ball thuds into middle stump
makes room to the sixth stump and pulls a shorter ball wide of midwicket
back to full and flat on the pads and Smith turns it away for one
some turn now, pitching outside leg stump and drawing a leading edge as Rohit plays the flick but looks on as the ball takes the splice and rolls to third man
slower ball, full outside leg, a mistimed sweep but still a leg bye
full and flat just outside leg stump, Rohit uses his feet and chips the ball inside out wide of Duminy at extra cover
low full toss outside off which is driven just wide of midwicket for one
another big heave, no real timing to speak of and he gets an inside edge to square leg, he was looking to line that one up for six more was Smith
pitched up and thats well driven down the ground for one more
fuller and straight and bunted back in the air to Raje's right, he gets a hand but parries it away and the umpire did well to jump out of the ball's path
massive! Smith just clears the front leg and tees off superbly, clubbing the slower ball from outside off stump and thats miles back over midwicket, really a great shot
comes onto the front foot and drives the full ball down to long-off
slows it up a tad, lands it on middle and leg, and Smith defends
flat on leg stump, and thats a very well played glance for four
shorter ball, still rather flat though, pitches outside leg stump and Smith is late on the pull, struck low but not in front of the stumps and the appeal is turned down
poor ball and now he manages to get bat on the sweep for one
flat outside leg stump, Rohit goes for the booming sweep but makes poor contact, the ball balloons up off his forearm
flat on middle and off, watchfully pushed in front of point for one
swings at one outside off again and gets it just wide of midwicket
right on the dime and Smith thuds bat and pad together in defence
bowled em! Raje holds his nerve and pitches it up on off stump, Gilchrist doesn't move his feet as he swings across the line and off stump is pegged back
full toss outside off which is hammered into the gap at midwicket, hard running gets him two, the sweeper returns it to his end but he's home safe, well run there
attempted yorker outside off, jammed out to backward point

short, wide, Rohit throws the bat at it and spoons it up and down to third man, but Jayasuriya does not pick it and is very slow to react ... it was a chance, but he didn't spot the ball and it dropped a few feet in front of him
shorter ball, Rohit gets up and checks the wrists, getting one to cover
full and wide and Gilchrist slices it in the air through the gap to the sweeper
shot and well fielded by Harbhajan at cover, the ball was full and wide and Gilchrist smacked it hard and the fielder slid to his left to save four
offers width, Gilchrist wafts at it and misses, done by the poor footwork
slides down and brushes the pads, Shah dives to his right and takes it
just a bit of room and Rohit drops it down backward of point for one
full and he comes forward, driving from outside off wide of mid-on
on the pads and easily tucked off for a single
another slower ball, fuller and Rohit comes onto the front foot, driving to extra cover where Harbhajan - sporting a black, Monty Panesar-like patka - is late to get there
shot! Just a bit too short from Raje and Rohit clubs it flat over midwicket
pitches it wider and gets some movement away from Rohit, whose feet don't move as he chases the ball and misses, well taken there by Shah too
back of a length on the pads and turned away for a single past midwicket
back to full and flat and he sweeps it through midwicket for one
slower ball, the slider, pitches outside off stump and skids on and Gilchrist is late on the push off the front foot for a sharp single, beats the bat and is saved by  the bounce
clean shot, man! Thats just picked up and swung away from outside off stump onto the roof over midwicket for a smashing six ... 106 meters mind you!
shorter ball, comes back in and Gilchrist defends to the off side
full on the pads again and Rohit opens up with a fluent clip for one
full and flat on leg stump, Gilchrist shuffles and clips to mid-on
pulls a short ball from outside off stump but straight to midwicket
fuller in length, gets him forward but he mistimes the drive to cover
very good length outside off and Rohit gets in line to play the ball back
got em! Suman backs away to try and hit the ball over cover but the ball was a touch too short for that shot and the extra bounce draws a thick outside edge to Shah

banged in short, Suman doesn't move as he tries to get onto the front foot and turn the slow bouncer away, makes a mess of it and pops the ball up in the air but  Bravo cannot run across to the leg side in time
short of a length on leg stump and patiently turned away for one
shuffles across early to try and tuck the ball but Harbhajan field it
another clean strike, just stood there and drilled the fuller, flatter ball up and over long-off for the second six of the over
pushed through flat down the pads, no bat but a leg bye to add
fuller and flatter but nicely tucked off the pads for a quick single
he goes hard, he goes straight, he goes six! Dances down to the inviting delivery and swings it high and over long-off for half a dozen
tossed up wide and Gilchrist drives hard to cover for a single
pitches back of a length on off and Gilchrist gently pushes to covers
good slower ball, much fuller on off and clipped just wide of midwicket
clever stuff, holding back the length outside off stump and Suman is beaten as he tries to open the face and dab the ball to third man, but his feet did not move
better ball, short of a length on middle and off and defended
fuller and straighter and again he swings at it, much better timing and his firm on-drive just beats mid-on and rolls away for four, he dived and misfield it
a big swing to one outside off stump, a real miscue but its up and over point and dropping safely in no mans land so Suman is off the mark with a couple
attempted yorker outside off, punched on the full to cover
bad ball, a full toss outside off stump which is slapped past point
this one's shorter and sliding down leg stump, Gilchrist goes for a big swing but no bat on that one, the ball swings off the pads and balloons up in front of square leg
very full just outside off, Gilchrist mistimes the drive back to Malinga
yorker length just outside off and driven to Bravo at cover
full on middle and leg, swinging in, and clipped to midwicket in the air, its not a catch and the fielder there falls back after stopping the ball
now theres a wayward ball! Slides out the hand early and ends up a very, very wide full toss that pitches and dribbles down in front of slip and the wicketkeeper
comes onto the front foot and drives but straight to point
much fuller a foot outside off stump and Suman shoulders arms

edged and gone! Gibbs pays the price for a poor drive away from the body, Kulkarni pitches it wide but it wasn't full enough for the drive and Gibbs gives Tendulkar at slip some regulation catching practice ... just wasn't to the pitch of the ball and went fishing
pitches it up, gets away movement, and no shot offered by Gibbs
short of a length and a bit wide, Gibbs gets thinking about the big shot but then checks the cut as the ball sort of stops on him, he picks out the off-side fielders
pitches well wide of off stump and swings away much further
full on the pads, Gibbs mistimes the flick straight to midwicket
superb bowling from Malinga, another moving yorker deviates through the air and Gilchrist does well to jam it out from middle and off to toward point
yorker once more, this one sliding down leg stump clearly, Gibbs tries the tickle and misses and Gilchrist calls him on for the leg bye
another yorker, this one off stump, Gilchrist inside-edges to short fine
lovely yorker, swinging through the air and Gilchrist is late on the flick, the ball moves very late and hits him on the foot and then almost rolls onto the stumps
full swinging yorker on the pads and thats really well played, just waited a fraction and then clipped the ball through square leg to the ropes
cant control this one down the pads, wide and swinging away
full toss to start off with, starting on off and swinging in and Gilchrist gets a thin inside edge as he shapes to work the ball to the on side
ends the match with a full toss which is pulled to midwicket
aims for leg stump with the full ball, batsman clears the front leg and swings hard, managing a little inside edge down toward short fine leg
makes room and pulls a length ball just wide of mid-on
yorker just outside off stump and he cannot get bat on ball
full just outside off stump, clears the leg and swings to square leg
sends down a full toss, which Kulkarni gets across to and paddles fine
good shot that! Harris errs in length with a half tracker and Raje gets into shape to pull that flat and just over the deep midwicket ropes for half a dozen
plants the back leg across off stump and drives hard at the full ball, just managing to get a wee bit of wood on the ball and it rolls into the covers
jumps back to the seventh stump and Harris follows him, beating bat
limply plays a short ball on the body, taking a hand off the bat, its up in the air and drops safely in front of square leg
smart bouncer, goes just over Raje's left shoulder
slides down the pads, Kulkarni works it away, a good throw comes in to Harris, who has plenty of time to dislodge the stumps but doesn't collect in cleanly and the batsman is just home
fires it in, batsman swings an inside edge just wide of square leg
flights it down leg stump and thats swung to the deep on one bounce
back to full and fast and thats driven to extra cover for one
simple stumping! Rohit proposes, Tiwary accepts, but he's a mile away from the ball as it breaks away from the stumps and an ecstatic Gilchrist takes care of the rest
fired in flat and Raje jams it out to midwicket

and he's got it! Rohit Sharma gets three in three! He fires down the leg stumps, no air whatsoever, Duminy moves back and tries to play it over square leg but gets a thin inside edge which Gilchrist, smartly anticipating, holds onto as he moves across
he's dropped it! Suman keeps it nice and straight, Tiwary backs away and drills it back very hard to the bowler, who grabs it near the midriff but lets it out
a bit straighter and he makes room to swing the ball away for two
flat again and he makes room to drive off the front foot to cover
slows the pace, lobs it up, he gets across and drives it straight
fired in well wide of off stump and Tiwary slashes just wide of cover

oh whats happening here? Suman flights it up gently on the stumps, Duminy walks across and plays a loose flick in the air, its a leading edge that pops up and Suman dives full stretch to his left but just cannot hang on
another one bites the dust! Rohit tosses it just a tad short outside off, Harbhajan plays a cheeky sweep to try and beat short fine leg but bottom-edges onto the stumps
bowled him, and Mumbai are losing the plot! Rohit keeps it flat on middle and leg, Nayar moves across to sweep and misses it, the ball doesn't turn that much and hits leg stump
shuffles in and then opens the face to steer it fine for a single that brings up a very cool half-century ... he has read the slow track well and needs to go on, with support
spears it down leg stump, Nayar makes room as he comes out and the ball hits his front pad before they steal a leg bye in front of midwicket
makes room and drives hard but cannot beat Gibbs at cover
slowly floats it up outside leg stump, Duminy cannot get bat on ball with the flick but Nayar is keen on the single and they scamper a leg bye
full, flat and clipped off the stumps for a cool single
slows the pace and lands it on a length and Duminy drives straight to cover
loses the grip due to the dew, the ball slips out a wide low full toss and Nayar chases it, getting an inside edge well back past Gilchrist
flatter ball on leg and he shuffles to clip the ball wide of midwicket
flights it on off stump and Duminy steers it straight to point

no, it works! Suman keeps it full and straight and flat and Bravo gets too underneath it as he looks to go straight for six but instead slices it way up in the air, Harris runs across to his right at long-off, takes it, and regains balance after a wobble
full and straight and he flicks with Caribbean flair for a single
full outside off now and he punches well but Gibbs intercepts at point
gets across the sticks and rolls the wrists on a straighter, shorter delivery, and looks on as the ball pops up and drops safely between midwicket and mid-on
full toss and Bravo cocks the wrists, punching down to long-off for two
nearly a yorker but Duminy comes onto the front foot, pushing the ball very near mid-off and sprinting down the other end, terrific running to keep the pressure on Deccan
pitches about in line and slants on to rap the pads well above of the pads, in fact its hit the thigh pad and the umpire completely ignores RP's appeal
comes forward to a fuller one and gets an inside edge which rolls safely back past the stumps, Bravo is alert and calls Duminy across for the single
beaten this time, trying to steer one that is too close to the body
short and he pirouettes to pull it very flat and low down into the gap behind square leg and the sweeper has no chance of cutting that off
short of a length and he works it off his hips for a quick single
bouncer now, Bravo flinches as the ball goes past his shoulder
and he beats Bravo first ball as he flirts from the crease and misses
whats this trash bowling? Another full toss and Duminy steers it to third man
another full toss that Bravo can only jam to mid-on for one
serves up a full toss, Bravo miscues the pull and just clears Rohit at short midwicket, he runs after it and dives valiantly and hits the turf smash on the face, ouch!
attempted yorker on middle and off, too full though and Bravo flicks to midwicket
yorker this time, swinging in to Duminy, who falls forward but still manages to pick the gap at midwicket for a quick single
bad ball, wide full toss which is pushed into the gap at cover for four
strays onto the pads and Duminy glances a single to fine leg
quicker ball pitches outside leg stump, Duminy's attempted flick is a fraction late and Suman gets all excited but Dharmasena, himself a former spinner, shakes his head
a touch too full and straight, Bravo flicks past midwicket and wants two but with two men converging on the ball Duminy shoos him back
flatter on the stumps and Bravo works it back to Suman
tossed up on a length outside off and Duminy punches one to cover
tossed up on middle and leg, Bravo adjusts and works it away for one
bad ball, short outside off stump and Duminy latches on with a firm pull to beat two men in the deep and take Mumbai into the strategy timeout with a bang

good shot from Bravo, reaching out to the wide ball, very full, and then opening face to chop it down to third man where Harmeet runs across and times his dive excellently to save a few runs, really good to see such an effort
too straight from him and Duminy turns it comfortably off the pads
pitches it up wide and Bravo chases expansively, driving in the air through cover and point to get off the mark
short this time and Duminy pulls with an inside edge past square leg
full down leg stump, beats the bat and Shoaib clears his throat but that was clearly doing too much
gently tossed up on the stumps and Duminy flicks wide of midwicket
Shah's fun ends with a slog to one tossed up slower outside off stump, he reaches out and drags it up in the air, from well outside off, and picks out Smith at wide long-on
now he uses his feet to flick the ball off his stumps, just wide of midwicket
flat outside leg stump, Duminy tries the flick but gets no timing at all
quicker, shorter, he gets back and mistimes the shot back
flat outside off, Duminy backs away and cuts to point
oh he's a confident little man, isn't he? Shah now unfurls a reverse sweep, pulled off with good placement for four, just taken from where it landed outside off stump
takes a low full toss and drives it down toward mid-off
hops about his crease and works a full ball from off stump to midwicket
pitches it up just outside off stump and Shah swings wildly, very lucky to get an inside edge off the toe end of the bat, which then rolls down to short third man
straighter ball, Duminy shuffles and clips it for a single
leans into a good-looking cover drive out to Teja, who fumbles
lovely paddle again from Shah, just kneeling across and scooping the ball from outside off stump well wide of the fielder for a four that raises Deccan's fifty
again onto the front foot, driving down to long-off for a single
comes forward and clips a full ball from outside off stump through midwicket for four, just lunged forward and flicked the wrists excellently
slower ball beats him, luring him forward and then cutting back
pitched up outside off, Duminy gets across and leaves it be
pitches just outside leg and beats Duminy's attempted tuck to square
heaves at a low full toss and RP does well fielding at midwicket
good old fashioned slog across the line, collecting from outside off stump and going hard and flat with the full ball over wide long-on for six more
pitches middle and off, swings in, and Duminy clips it away
shorter in length, and straighter too, Shah uses his feet and swings but doesn't make good contact and gets a loose single down the ground
slower ball, Shah reaches out and slogs to midwicket
super shop from Shah! Just gets the wrists into play, flicking the half volley off the pads and times it rather well to go over Harmeet's head at deep square leg
short and he pulls with one hand off the bat, just over midwicket, drops safely and the sweeper has some ground to cover so thats a frenetic couple more to the total
banged in short, Shah pulls off the splice of the bat and just pops the top edge over mid-on's head for a single
aha, so he does have some shots! Shah now walks across the stumps and produces a smart paddle shot with fine leg up, makes good connection and gets four
walks across the stumps but can only push the ball back to Harmeet
slants back inside off the upright seam, cuts in and beats Shah as he looks to work the ball away to the onside
beats him first ball, Shah dances down and plays down the wrong line, just pusin at a length ball that beats the bat with ease
short and he swats it across the stumps, Harmeet Singh at deep fine leg dives and doesn't stop the ball from crossing the ropes
good ball, just pitched up outside off and this one sits up and swings away to beat Duminy as he drives loosely away from the body
slides in and raps the pad going down leg, a muted appeal from all
short and down leg stump, Duminy hooks and gets a faint touch
slides down the pads off a shorter length,  theres a noise as the ball brushes Duminy's pads, Gilchrist collects and RP sets off in celebration but Benson signals wide
full outside off stump and squeezed to point on the bounce
full on off stump and played back to RP
backs himself to play urgently and just manages to go over midwicket's head with a loose chip across the stumps to one pitched up
on the stumps and gently turned off the pads to midwicket
full down the pads, Shah drives and gets a thin inside edge
comes forward and dabs the ball square on the off side, sets off immediately and does well to make his ground at the other end as Smith's throw is a shade late
pitches a foot outside off and shapes back in, Duminy covers the stumps and gets stuck between leaving and playing and in the end goes for the first choice
good ball, pitching on off stump and moving away from Shah, who pushes at it and squirts it just wide of backward point for a single
pitches back of a length and slants too far down leg stump, Duminy is late on the defensive but there is no appeal from RP ... but what an over from him and for Deccan

oh lovely stuff! RP gets two in two, pitching the ball up and getting some swing back in to Tendulkar, whose feet go nowhere as he tries to get smart and turn the ball off his stumps but the result is a thin inside edge that disturbs the furniture

oh well held Harris! Jayasuriya comes down and RP sees him, holding back the length and the result is a slash up and over gully and then out of nowhere comes Harris from third man, covering good ground and diving forward toward his right to hold a stunner
a bit fuller, brings Jayasuriya forward and he pushes right to point
short of a length outside off and Jayasuriya gets up to defend it back
starts off on a length with a shape of swing, Tendulkar thrusts forward and gets an inside edge in front of midwicket
good ball, holds back the length and slants it across from leg stump, Jayasuriya tries to roll the wrists but the ball stops on him and he chips it back wide of Harris
now he gets timing and placement and slashes the wide ball just over cover and thats a great shot to get the dancers gyrating
sees room outside off and flashes but no contact, so nearly an edge
again a touch too straight and this time its turned wide of midwicket
slants onto the pads and Tendulkar turns it comfortably to midwicket
starts off outside leg stump and Jayasuriya scampers one off the pads
